manifest: SHA256SUMS (paths relative to evidenceDir; the retained 10k and 1k seed clones are not hashed, they are APFS clones of work-P5B-R3 and never opened read-write)

runs.base-w1-a, base-w4-a: step 1 instrumented baseline (10k, owner-routed reads, load 10 to 15)
runs.d1-w1, d2-w1, d4-w1, d7-w1, d8-w1: step 2: one W1 run after each CPU fix
runs.s3-w1, s3-w248, s3-fp-w4, s3-1k, s3-ckpt: step 3: direct reads, pipelined publisher, workers 1 2 4 8; s3-fp-w4 carries G-FP before and after; s3-1k feeds the fit; s3-ckpt records checkpoint events
runs.rec: G-REC: real SIGKILL of the sweep controller at three points
runs.lat: sweep ratio, stopped after 6 rounds (5 pairs, 1 A/A); lat-aa-analysis.json is the p5n-aa.mjs verdict
runs.*-failed-*: runs that stopped on a harness error, kept: close timeout masked by finally (s3-wsweep-failed-close), G-JNL API (…-g-jnl-api), reverse match scan (…-failed-reverse), counts basis (…-failed-counts), child done message (rec-failed-done-message)
